cases.input: A shift handover records open work and incoming acknowledgment before the incoming party acts.
cases.expect: Accepted and attributable without creating any IAM right.

cases.input: RosterShift, ShiftOverride and DutyHandover objects are defined with their own identities and required fields, each shift citing a standingAssignmentRef.
cases.expect: Accepted; the owned facts have carriers and the eligibility, substitution and handover invariants become testable.

cases.input: A DutyHandover from A to B is recorded with atInstant and open work but no acknowledgment and no gapRecorded.
cases.expect: Rejected; silence is neither acceptance nor an implicit gap and must be recorded explicitly.

cases.input: C substitutes for B via a ShiftOverride with authorizerRef and effectiveAt while the roster revision digest is unchanged.
cases.expect: Accepted; the effective shift changes through an overlay and the immutable revision is not rewritten.

cases.input: Revisions 3 and 4 of one roster both cover the instant used to resolve an escalation target.
cases.expect: Rejected; effective revision intervals must not overlap for as-of resolution.

cases.input: A shift boundary falls in a repeated local hour and the revision declares no dstPolicy.
cases.expect: Rejected; DST gaps and overlaps require a declared per-schedule resolution policy.

cases.input: The roster root is set to superseded with successorRef to a second roster identity while its revisions are unchanged.
cases.expect: Rejected; supersession is revision-level and the root identity remains stable.

cases.input: The roster is set to retired with no retiredAt and with in-flight executions and open incidents unenumerated.
cases.expect: Rejected; retirement requires its instant and an explicit statement of uncovered open work.

cases.input: B records an action under in-flight execution E2 before the handover acknowledgment instant.
cases.expect: Rejected; the incoming party may not act under an in-flight change before acknowledgment.

cases.input: DutyRoster.references retains WM-KNW-012 and WM-KNW-013 while excluding escalation identity.
cases.expect: Rejected; the dependency is one-way from rule to roster.
